control_failures.control_label: integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: unplanned release of thermal energy at SG-9000

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas on SG-9000 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically inspecting and maintaining portable equipment. SG-9000 (mine switchgear) is in service for pit and workshop distribution. The task proceeded during a breakdown response while the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was in place but did not perform. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 29 August 2021 a potential incident was recorded on SG-9000 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during a breakdown response; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
